sections.overview: Psednos anoderkes is a small snailfish (family Liparidae) known from the eastern pacific, northeast of isla guadalupe, mexico.
sections.identification: It has a small upward-looking eye, pale skin, 37 dorsal soft rays and 42 vertebrae. P. andriashevi has 42 rays and 47 vertebrae. P. barnardi has 39–41 rays and 47 vertebrae, with a black chin.
sections.habitat: It is a marine midwater fish recorded between 0 and 2036 m over deep seafloor.
sections.diet: The species account and original description do not report a species-specific diet.
sections.behavior: No behavior is described in the species account.
sections.reproduction: The reviewed species sources do not describe reproduction.
sections.ecology: The known records are sparse; the reported maximum is 2.7 cm standard length.
sections.conservation: FishBase reports it as not evaluated on the IUCN Red List.
